quests.instruction: Which vehicle drives on the road and carries a family to the shop?
quests.question: Car
quests.hint: Think about the vehicle your family rides in almost every day.
quests.explanation: A car is a vehicle with four wheels that drives on roads. Cars carry families to school, shops, and parks!
quests.funFact: There are more cars in the world than almost any other kind of vehicle!

quests.instruction: Which big vehicle drives on the road and carries many passengers at once?
quests.question: Bus
quests.hint: Think about the long vehicle that stops to pick up lots of people along the street.
quests.explanation: A bus is a big vehicle that carries many passengers together. Buses have many seats and one driver!
quests.funFact: One bus can carry as many people as ten or more cars!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle rolls along metal tracks, click-clacking as it carries hundreds of people?
quests.question: Train
quests.hint: Think about the long vehicle that only moves on special metal rails.
quests.explanation: A train is a long vehicle that runs on metal tracks called rails. Trains can carry hundreds of passengers!
quests.funFact: Trains travel on tracks so they always know exactly which way to go!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle floats on a lake or river and can be rowed or driven by a motor?
quests.question: Boat
quests.hint: Think about a small vehicle that floats on water, smaller than a big ship.
quests.explanation: A boat is a small vehicle that floats and travels on water. Boats can be rowed, sailed, or driven by a motor!
quests.funFact: The very first boats were made from hollowed-out logs thousands of years ago!

quests.instruction: Which giant vehicle floats on the ocean and carries huge amounts of cargo or passengers?
quests.question: Ship
quests.hint: Think about a much bigger version of a boat that crosses whole oceans.
quests.explanation: A ship is a very large vehicle that travels across oceans. Ships can carry huge amounts of cargo or many passengers!
quests.funFact: Some ships are so big they can carry thousands of shipping containers at once!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle has big wings and flies high above the clouds?
quests.question: Airplane
quests.hint: Think about the vehicle that flies you far away on holiday, way up in the sky.
quests.explanation: An airplane is a vehicle with wings that flies through the sky. Airplanes carry people on long trips very quickly!
quests.funFact: An airplane can fly so high that it travels above most of the clouds in the sky!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle has two wheels and moves when you pedal with your feet?
quests.question: Bicycle
quests.hint: Think about the two-wheeled vehicle you balance on and pedal yourself.
quests.explanation: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels that you pedal with your feet. Riding a bicycle is great exercise!
quests.funFact: A bicycle is one of the most energy-saving ways for a person to travel!

quests.instruction: Which big vehicle has a large back area for carrying heavy loads?
quests.question: Truck
quests.hint: Think about the big vehicle that carries furniture or boxes from place to place.
quests.explanation: A truck is a big vehicle with a large space in the back for carrying loads. Trucks deliver goods to stores!
quests.funFact: Big trucks help carry almost everything you buy in a store from factories to shops!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle has two wheels, a motor, and a rider who wears a helmet?
quests.question: Motorcycle
quests.hint: Think about a fast two-wheeled vehicle with an engine, ridden with a helmet on.
quests.explanation: A motorcycle is a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine. Motorcycle riders always wear a helmet to stay safe!
quests.funFact: Motorcycles can turn and move through traffic much faster than most cars!

quests.instruction: Which flying vehicle has spinning blades on top instead of wings?
quests.question: Helicopter
quests.hint: Think about the flying vehicle with a spinning top that can hover in one spot.
quests.explanation: A helicopter is a flying vehicle with spinning blades on top. Helicopters can hover in the air without moving!
quests.funFact: Helicopters can take off and land straight up and down without needing a runway!

quests.instruction: Which car do people pay to ride in, often colored bright yellow?
quests.question: Taxi
quests.hint: Think about the car you can wave down on a street to get a ride for a fee.
quests.explanation: A taxi is a car that people pay to ride in. Taxis pick up passengers and drive them where they need to go!
quests.funFact: In many big cities, taxis are painted bright yellow so they are easy to spot!

quests.instruction: Which small vehicle has two wheels and a stand-up platform you push with one foot?
quests.question: Scooter
quests.hint: Think about the small ride you stand on and push along with one foot.
quests.explanation: A scooter is a small vehicle with two wheels and a platform to stand on. We push a scooter along with one foot!
quests.funFact: Scooters are a fun and quick way to zip around your neighborhood!

quests.instruction: Which big vehicle with huge back wheels works hard on a farm?
quests.question: Tractor
quests.hint: Think about the strong vehicle a farmer drives to plow the fields.
quests.explanation: A tractor is a strong vehicle used on farms. Tractors help farmers plow fields and pull heavy equipment!
quests.funFact: A tractor's huge back wheels help it grip and drive through muddy farm fields!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle looks like a big box on wheels and can carry lots of people or cargo?
quests.question: Van
quests.hint: Think about a vehicle bigger than a car but smaller than a bus, shaped like a box.
quests.explanation: A van is a box-shaped vehicle bigger than a car. Vans can carry many passengers or lots of cargo!
quests.funFact: Many families choose a van when they need extra room for people and luggage!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle rushes to help sick or hurt people, with flashing lights and a loud siren?
quests.question: Ambulance
quests.hint: Think about the vehicle with a siren that hurries people safely to the hospital.
quests.explanation: An ambulance is a special vehicle that rushes people to the hospital. Ambulances have flashing lights and loud sirens!
quests.funFact: Ambulances carry special medical equipment to help people right away!

quests.instruction: Which big red vehicle rushes to fires carrying hoses, ladders, and brave firefighters?
quests.question: Fire Truck
quests.hint: Think about the big red vehicle that races to help put out a fire.
quests.explanation: A fire truck is a big vehicle that carries firefighters and hoses. Fire trucks rush quickly to help put out fires!
quests.funFact: Fire trucks carry very long ladders that can reach all the way up tall buildings!

quests.instruction: Which car has flashing red and blue lights and helps keep our streets safe?
quests.question: Police Car
quests.hint: Think about the car with special lights that officers drive to help keep people safe.
quests.explanation: A police car is a car that police officers drive to keep people safe. Police cars have flashing red and blue lights!
quests.funFact: Police cars have a special radio so officers can talk to each other and stay connected!

quests.instruction: Which train travels underground beneath a busy city?
quests.question: Subway
quests.hint: Think about a train that runs on tracks hidden below the streets of a big city.
quests.explanation: A subway is a train that travels underground. Subways help people travel quickly under busy city streets!
quests.funFact: Some of the biggest cities in the world have subway tunnels running for hundreds of miles!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle rides on tracks built right into a city street?
quests.question: Tram
quests.hint: Think about a train-like vehicle that shares the road with cars in a city.
quests.explanation: A tram is a vehicle that rides on tracks built into a city street. Trams carry passengers around busy towns!
quests.funFact: Trams are powered by electricity from wires above the street, so they make very little noise!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle floats gently through the sky, lifted up by a giant colorful balloon?
quests.question: Hot Air Balloon
quests.hint: Think about a big, colorful balloon with a basket that carries people up into the sky.
quests.explanation: A hot air balloon is a vehicle lifted by a giant balloon filled with hot air. It floats gently through the sky!
quests.funFact: A hot air balloon rises because the hot air inside is lighter than the cool air outside!

quests.instruction: Which boat carries cars and passengers back and forth across a body of water?
quests.question: Ferry
quests.hint: Think about a boat that makes the exact same short trip across the water again and again.
quests.explanation: A ferry is a boat that carries cars and passengers across water. Ferries travel the same route back and forth!
quests.funFact: Some ferries are big enough to carry hundreds of cars at the very same time!

quests.instruction: Which narrow boat do you paddle using a single-bladed paddle?
quests.question: Canoe
quests.hint: Think about a slim, pointy boat you paddle while kneeling or sitting low inside it.
quests.explanation: A canoe is a narrow boat you move using a paddle. People paddle canoes on calm rivers and lakes!
quests.funFact: Canoes were first built by carefully hollowing out a single log!

quests.instruction: Which narrow boat do you paddle using a paddle with a blade on both ends?
quests.question: Kayak
quests.hint: Think about a boat you sit low inside, paddling with blades on each end of one long paddle.
quests.explanation: A kayak is a narrow boat you paddle with a two-bladed paddle. Kayaks are fast and easy to steer!
quests.funFact: Kayaks were first invented by Arctic hunters to move quietly through icy water!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle can dive deep underwater and travel hidden beneath the waves?
quests.question: Submarine
quests.hint: Think about the only vehicle that can travel completely underwater for a long time.
quests.explanation: A submarine is a vehicle that travels underwater. Submarines can dive deep beneath the ocean waves!
quests.funFact: A submarine can stay hidden underwater for weeks by making its own fresh air!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle blasts off with fire and smoke to travel all the way into space?
quests.question: Rocket
quests.hint: Think about the vehicle with a powerful engine that blasts off the ground into outer space.
quests.explanation: A rocket is a vehicle that blasts off into space. Rockets need enormous power to leave the Earth!
quests.funFact: A rocket must travel incredibly fast to escape the pull of Earth's gravity!

quests.instruction: Which small four-wheeled cart do children pull along by a long handle?
quests.question: Wagon
quests.hint: Think about a little cart with four wheels that you pull by a handle to carry toys.
quests.explanation: A wagon is a small cart with four wheels and a pulling handle. Children use wagons to carry toys around!
quests.funFact: Long ago, much bigger wagons pulled by horses carried whole families across the country!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle glides over snow on smooth, flat runners instead of wheels?
quests.question: Sled
quests.hint: Think about the vehicle you sit on to slide down a snowy, icy hill.
quests.explanation: A sled is a vehicle that glides over snow on smooth runners. We ride sleds down snowy hills!
quests.funFact: Sleds have no wheels at all, just smooth runners that glide easily over snow!

quests.instruction: Which boat uses a big cloth sail and the power of the wind to move?
quests.question: Sailboat
quests.hint: Think about a boat with a tall cloth sail that catches the wind to push it along.
quests.explanation: A sailboat is a boat that uses a sail to catch the wind. Sailboats move without using any motor at all!
quests.funFact: Sailors turn the sail to catch the wind from almost any direction!

quests.instruction: Which small boat do you move by pulling two oars through the water?
quests.question: Rowboat
quests.hint: Think about a simple boat you move by pulling two long oars, one in each hand.
quests.explanation: A rowboat is a small boat moved by pulling oars. We row a rowboat by pulling the oars through the water!
quests.funFact: Rowing a boat uses strong muscles in your arms, back, and legs all at once!

quests.instruction: Which flat board on four small wheels do you ride standing up?
quests.question: Skateboard
quests.hint: Think about a flat wooden board with wheels that you stand and balance on to roll along.
quests.explanation: A skateboard is a flat board with four small wheels. We stand on a skateboard and push with one foot!
quests.funFact: Skateboarding started when people attached roller skate wheels to wooden boards!
